### Gospel Readiness
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gospel-readiness
Passage: Ephesians 6:15
Points:
- Roman soldiers relied on sturdy footwear to sustain long marches and keep secure footing in combat.
- The gospel of peace sustains believers throughout the long and difficult march of the Christian life.
- Assurance of reconciliation with God provides a firm foundation to resist Satan's discouraging accusations.
- Because our standing rests on Christ rather than our own efforts, we can repent and stand firm.

### Becoming Strong in Our Struggles
Author: Cindi McMenamin
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/becoming-strong-in-our-struggles-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Ephesians 6:10-11
Points:
- Painful circumstances and emotional wounds are battlegrounds where the enemy seeks to leave believers debilitated.
- God calls believers to respond not as defeated victims, but as empowered spiritual warriors.
- Putting on God's armor is synonymous with clothing yourself in the character and truth of Christ.
- Believers stand firm against the devil's lies by abiding in Jesus and claiming His victory.
